Weighting these variations by species population density suggests a global average of roughly 625 spots per adult giraffe.
3.  **Calculation:** 120,000 giraffes × 625 spots/giraffe = 75,000,000 total spots.

This estimate assumes "black spots" refers to the standard dark pigment patches (which range from dark brown to black) visible on the coat, as is the common colloquial definition. The estimate significantly exceeds your threshold of 41,000,000.
